keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Tonny Vilhena (Willem II).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nathan Tjoe-A-On (Willem II) is shown the yellow card.
Second yellow card to Nathan Tjoe-A-On (Willem II) for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Twente 0, Willem II 0.
Substitution, Willem II. Finn Stam replaces Tonny Vilhena.
Second Half begins Twente 0, Willem II 0.
Goal! Twente 0, Willem II 1. Devin Haen (Willem II) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Hidde ter Avest following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Willem II. Anass Zarrouk replaces Vito van Crooij.
Goal! Twente 1, Willem II 1. Ramiz Zerrouki (Twente) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Daouda Weidmann.
Substitution, Twente. Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink replaces Aske Adelgaard.
Substitution, Twente. Marko Pjaca replaces Younes Taha.
Delay in match because of an injury Maxime Delanghe (Willem II).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Twente. Kristian Hlynsson replaces Sondre Ørjasæter.
Substitution, Willem II. Per van Loon replaces Calvin Twigt.
Substitution, Willem II. Chido Obi replaces Devin Haen.
Goal! Twente 2, Willem II 1. Marko Pjaca (Twente) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kristian Hlynsson with a cross.
Substitution, Twente. Stav Lemkin replaces Wout Weghorst.
Substitution, Willem II. Jaden Slory replaces Kasper Boogaard.
Ruud Nijstad (Twente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Uriel van Aalst (Willem II).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Twente 2, Willem II 1.
